# Cullum & Co — Scott Cullum

> I'm Scott Cullum, a creative technologist and hands-on technical leader. I help teams turn early ideas into working products.

Cullum & Co is my practice. I shape the experience, build prototypes to test difficult ideas, and guide the technical decisions behind delivery.

## How I help

- Direction and decisions: product priorities, feasibility, technical scoping, and next steps
- Prototyping and technical leadership: prototypes, front-end architecture, design systems, and hands-on collaboration
- Helping teams work better: workflows, design/engineering collaboration, and coaching on AI tools and agents

## How engagements work

I usually work part-time as a fractional partner, combining advisory support with hands-on work. I use AI tools and agents where they help me explore and build, and bring in trusted collaborators when an engagement needs more depth.
